summary.scope: refine the 51 previously shortlisted candidates from 197 A-family train identities
summary.selection_policy: P1 is one method family, not a universal prover. Deferred formulas are not declared unprovable.

criteria.target_first_order: After justified normalization, F(n+1,k)/F(n,k), F(n,k+1)/F(n,k), and T(n+1)/T(n) must be rational in the chosen single-base shift variables. q-Gosper must then construct the target-difference antidifference, with original-domain local, support, boundary, initial and recurrence obligations closed.
criteria.direct_q_gosper: With external parameters held fixed, the actual summand must have a rational single-base shift ratio; a q-hypergeometric antidifference must be constructed and its endpoint difference must match the original target. Parameter dependence on n is mathematically allowed even though the current emitter is narrower.
criteria.limits: Rational shift ratios are necessary structural evidence, not a guarantee of a certificate. Constructing a certificate over the formal field is not a Lean proof over the original domain.

notes: The rest of the 197 formulas were not reclassified as mathematically inapplicable.
The four probes are explicit research transcriptions, not automatic Lean-expression extraction.
No identity-specific proof content, certificate or recurrence answer was added to the production pipeline.
